# Sync bulk-action buttons do not submit the selection form

The accepted sync template uses native checkbox inputs inside wrapping labels, explicit type=button for the two bulk actions, and a separate hidden submit button. Preserve the bulk buttons’ type when changing this form so Select all does not also advance the setup flow. The decorative icons have alt="". This is scoped control-source guidance; trusted keyboard activation, focus order, announcements and screen-reader names were not checked. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.

Scope: Account Hub sync native controls.
